chunks.text: 4.27.1 Relevant Legislation Trade Marks Act 1995 Part 13 Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks Trade Marks Regulations 1995 Part 13 Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks 4.27.2 General Description Holders of a protected international trade mark can object to the importation of goods which infringe their trade mark by giving a notice to the Australian Customs Service. For further information the Australian Border Force can be contacted: https://www.abf.gov.au/help-and-support/contact-us/telephone.
